climate.headline: Typhoon Champi hits north-east Taiwan, hundreds injured and nearly 1,000 flights cancelled
climate.detail: Peak winds near 300 km/h as a super typhoon; up to 900 mm rain forecast; 56,000 households lost power; about 8,400 Okinawa homes lost power. Event of 23 Oct, before this period.
climate.source: Taiwan Central Weather Administration and JTWC, as reported by Al Jazeera, 23 Oct 2026

climate.headline: EU gas storage 74.6% full as Oseberg outage widens; TTF at EUR 96/MWh
climate.detail: Lowest late-October level since 2009 (average about 86%, last year 95%). Gassco raised the Oseberg cut to 12.7 million cubic metres a day; early-November cold may start drawdowns.
climate.source: GIE AGSI data (as of 25 Oct) and Gassco, as reported by Yahoo Finance, 27 Oct 2026

climate.headline: El Nino drought leaves Kapuas River low, half of West Kalimantan palm mill capacity affected
climate.detail: 13 of 50 mills affected; GAPKI cut its 2026 national output forecast 2.9%; Borneo Q4 output could fall 12-15%. Report dated 19 Oct.
climate.source: GAPKI figures reported by Reuters (via Devdiscourse), 19 Oct 2026

spreads.name: Copper to gold ratio
spreads.note: Copper USD per pound divided by gold USD per ounce, times 1000. A familiar growth-versus-safety gauge.
